column9: Windsor Public Schools 1:1 Chromebook district (Google Apps for Education); all students grades 2-12 assigned Chromebooks, K-1 iPad carts. Specific launch year not located.
North Haven Public Schools 1:1 Chromebook program for grades K-12; students 3-12 take devices home. Launch year not pinned in public sources.
Monroe CT public schools - no specific 1:1 launch documentation surfaced. District has student devices (typical CT pattern).
Cabrillo Unified supports ~3000 mobile devices for ~2800 students per district tech page. Specific 1:1 launch year not documented in public sources.
Henderson ISD "in the middle of a one-to-one device initiative" per Aug 2016 Longview News-Journal article on district 125th anniversary. Chromebooks/iPads for nearly all students.
Bristol-Warren Regional School District 1:1 device initiative documented in 2017 Digital Promise case study; network upgrades, 5-year refresh plan, Digital Learning Teams.
Chartiers Valley SD is one-to-one with iPads, Chromebooks, and laptops per district FAQ. Launch year not specified.
Hertford County Schools provides Chromebooks to students; district tech FAQ at HCMS describes 1:1 device program. Specific launch year not located.
Per Taos News reporting, every Taos Municipal Schools student has a Google Chromebook. Specific launch year not documented in public sources.
Neshoba County School District Chromebook deployment per NREA case study: 1:1 grades 3-5; 1:1.5 middle school; 1:2 K-2 and high school. Tiered rollout, infrastructure upgrade.
Orchard View Schools (Muskegon) uses Chromebooks; OVHS has Chromebook insurance forms. Specific 1:1 launch year not located.
Grant Parish School Board - no specific 1:1 launch documentation surfaced in web search.
Lansing SD 158 offers one-to-one computing per district overview; PreK-8 elementary district. Launch year not specified in public sources.
Oak Park Unified 1-to-1 Chromebook program implemented at OPUSD per Talon (student newspaper) article dated Sept 19, 2019; pilot at Medea Creek MS approved March 2018, expansion to gr 5-12 fall 2019.
Safford USD 1 - all SUSD students may check out Chromebook for free home use; one-to-one initiative referenced in district tech communications. Launch year not documented in available sources.
Franklin County School District 1:1 Chromebook Program with district handbook on schoolinsites; per-student device loan with AUP. Launch year not specified.
Hampshire County Schools WV - no specific 1:1 launch documentation surfaced; district has student devices.
Alvarado ISD school board approved 650 Chromebooks for new junior high; classroom carts with home checkout option. Specific year not documented.
Hollidaysburg Area SD high school has been one-to-one Chromebook for five years per 2024-25 Chromebook handbook (calc: ~2019-20 launch); Google for Education Reference District.
Grants-Cibola County Schools - superintendent referenced students having Chromebooks (some 6-year-old); district provides devices. Specific launch year not documented.
Princeton ISD 477 1:1 Chromebook program for grades 3-12; PIS is 1:1 technology district per district pages. Specific launch year not located, distance learning ramp 2020-21.

column9: Oak Park Schools (Michigan) operates a 2-to-1 Chromebook program per district technology page (not full 1:1).
Clio Area Schools (Genesee County MI) - no specific 1:1 launch documentation found in public web search; district uses Chromebooks.
Westwood Public Schools high school 1:1 Chromebook initiative launched September 2013 (announced in Boston Globe Dec 2012); pilot 2011-2012 in four classrooms. Later expanded to grades 6-12.
Franklin Parish (Winnsboro LA) - no specific 1:1 launch documentation surfaced.
Bradford County School District is 1:1 at high school per Renaissance case study; rest of district not full 1:1 at time of source.
Wallingford-Swarthmore SD board unanimously approved lease of 1,300 Chromebooks for every student at Strath Haven Middle School in April 2015 board meeting; later extended to grades 6-12 take-home.
Coos Bay School District 9 has Chromebook Help Desk and student Chromebook checkout; full 1:1 program in place. Specific launch year not located.
Wyckoff School District has Chromebook 1:1 Classroom site; PreK-8 district. Specific launch year not located in available web sources.
Ewing Township schools issue Chromebooks district-wide with Acceptable Use Policy; e-textbooks referenced since 2016 but explicit 1:1 launch year not documented.
Ferndale Public Schools (Oakland County MI) - K-1 iPad 2:1; grades 2-12 1:1 Chromebook/Windows; grade 6-12 take home. Specific launch year not documented.
Norwood Public Schools 1:1 Chromebook initiative implemented during 2018-2019 school year per Norwood Patch article; all grades 6-12 assigned own Chromebook (NHS, Coakley MS).
Grafton Public Schools 1:1 iPad program at high school; expanded one-to-one to grades 6-8 starting 2020-2021 per district sources. Chromebooks used grades 2-8.
Dennis-Yarmouth Regional - no specific 1:1 launch documentation surfaced in web search.
Boyd County Public Schools (KY) - district uses Chromebooks; no specific 1:1 launch documentation surfaced in web search.
Bellevue Union Elementary (Sonoma County CA) - no specific 1:1 launch documentation surfaced.
Butler County Schools (AL) - no specific 1:1 launch documentation surfaced in web search.

Watertown Unified SD uses Chromebooks/Chromeboxes; WUSD board approved purchase of 885 Chromebooks per Watertown Daily Times reporting. Per WHS staff/students/admin all use Chromebooks. Launch year not pinned.
Lexington County SD 4 (Swansea SC) - no specific 1:1 launch documentation surfaced.
Penn-Delco SD 1:1 Chromebook program for secondary students per district tech page; Sun Valley HS uses Schoology. Specific launch year not located.
Pendleton SD 16R - Chromebook handbook published Aug 2020; students issued Chromebooks for home use. Earlier launch year not pinned in available sources.
Meramec Valley R-III SD - Pacific HS Chrome-land Security IT courses approved 2019-20; district uses Chromebooks. Specific 1:1 launch year not documented.
Laurel SD (Mississippi) 1:1 Program provides each student with Chromebook/iPad/laptop; uses ClassLink and Schoology. Specific launch year not documented.
North Branch Area Schools 1:1 Chromebook program for grades 5-12 with $20 annual fee. Launch year not specified.
RSU 14 Windham Raymond - no specific 1:1 launch documentation surfaced; Maine state MLTI program covers grades 7-12 historically (2002+).
South Portland Schools historically had 1:1 netbook program for 4th-5th grades; Maine MLTI covers 7-12. Current full-district 1:1 launch year not documented.
New London Public Schools 1:1 device program: iPads K-2; Chromebooks/laptops 3-12. Launch year not specified.
Smith County Schools (Carthage TN) - no specific 1:1 launch documentation surfaced.

Abington Heights School District (Clarks Summit PA) - no specific 1:1 launch documentation surfaced; not to be confused with Abington SD (Montgomery Co) which approved 5-yr digital plan in spring 2019.
Northeastern Local SD (Springfield, Clark County OH) issues Chromebooks to students with $50 tech fee and signed AUP/Student Agreement. Launch year not documented.
